prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Katy, Texas, and was completing a left turn when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the cross street. Responding officers arrived and found both vehicles resting in the roadway with visible front-end damage to Driver 2's vehicle and a crushed driver-side door and quarter panel on Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the angle and speed of the impact described at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 turned in front of them, and two independent witnesses gave statements that match that account. Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed and show damage patterns consistent with the reported sequence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 reported neck and lower back pain and was evaluated by medical personnel on scene. Driver 1 was the operator of the vehicle, and it was not fully clear from the statements where in the vehicle they were seated at the moment of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. A passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was not reported as injured.
